ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the left side of the figure is pathway A. The nerve center sends out nerve fibers, which pass through a neuron, and their terminals connect near the heart effector; beside the heart is labeled "receptor", and beside the site where the terminal of pathway A acts on the heart is labeled "norepinephrine". Then reason: The question asks about the neurotransmitter released by the nerve terminal in pathway A that can act on the effector and excite it. According to the corresponding label at the terminal of pathway A in the figure, this neurotransmitter is norepinephrine.
